panel.title: Preview
switcher.label: Preview surface
empty.no-document.detail: Open a form schema to see the preview.
empty.no-schema.detail: The buffer holds what you typed; the preview will render once the text is a schema.
empty.no-loader.detail: Composition gave the preview no module loader, so sidecars are not executed.
refusal.source-forbids-code: The source does not allow executing its code, so form sidecars are not compiled.
refusal.source-unknown: The document source is unknown: executing code is refused until a project is open.
fallback.unknown-surface: Surface "{requested}" is gone — showing an available one.
fallback.not-applicable: Surface "{requested}" does not accept this document — showing an available one.
